input_files.rule: Tests create temporary directories. Production scans hotspot roots on the local machine. Helpers must skip junctions and must not trash without this-turn approval.

contracts.output contract: Scan JSON, static HTML, optional REPORT_URL. server.py accepts trash and open only; rm is disabled.
contracts.rollback boundary: Trash is reversible until the Recycle Bin is emptied. Static reports do not mutate. No undo sidecar in v1.
